statistics: Paired training-seed differences; two-sided exact sign-flip tests, Holm correction across the three primary contrasts; bootstrap paired-seed CIs. Scene sampling uncertainty is not included in seed-only intervals.
stopping: Fixed interaction/update budgets. Only infrastructure/time limits may interrupt; no performance-based stopping or checkpoint selection.
success: Reach within 8 cm for final three steps; touch physical contact for any three consecutive steps; grasp-lift held target at least 14 cm above initial center and hand within 13 cm of lift goal for final three steps.
interpretation: Spatial/contact goals and a CEM task cost are supplied. Language is part of experience, not the primary score. No general intelligence, language instruction-following or consciousness claim. Eight seeds do not constitute a prospective power analysis.
